answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a digital quill for identity validation, tethering influence to locked capital rather than mere node count. This mechanism creates a vine of economic dependency where each agent’s stake serves as a haven against network fragmentation. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities must commit significant assets to the protocol, rendering the cost of Sybil creation prohibitive as the price of capital acquisition exceeds the marginal benefit of network subversion.
